new_jobs.jd: \*\*Job Overview\*\* We are seeking an experienced Sales Operations Director to bridge Sales commitments and factory execution, overseeing end-to-end NPI delivery, order management, pricing, CRM data, and sales forecasting support. This role will lead the integration of operations teams, systems, and processes, establishing unified workflows and operational standards to improve efficiency and ensure business continuity. As a hands-on leader, you will work closely with global customers, factories, procurement, finance, and Sales teams to resolve operational challenges and ensure on-time delivery, accurate pricing, and seamless customer service. \*\*Job Description\*\* * Delivery & Order Management * NPI Project Management: Manage end-to-end NPI delivery from project award, sample validation to mass production, ensuring schedules and customer expectations are met. * Factory Coordination: Coordinate production, resolve manufacturing issues, and ensure on-time shipments. * Order Management: Oversee customer orders, material inventory, and shipping documentation. * Pricing & Cost Management: Maintain accurate pricing and coordinate cost updates throughout EVT/DVT/PVT phases. * Payment & AR Management: Monitor customer payments, accounts receivable, and billing accuracy. * After-Sales Support: Manage spare parts, repair materials, and after-sales support operations. * Operations Integration * Operations Integration: Lead the integration of cross-functional operations teams and processes, covering order management, NPI, pricing, and spare parts. * Systems & Data Integration: Drive SAP and Salesforce integration to streamline order, pricing, and inventory management. * Business Continuity: Ensure seamless customer delivery and support during operational transitions. * CRM & Sales Forecasting Support * CRM Data Management: Ensure accurate and up-to-date customer, opportunity, pricing, and order information in Salesforce. * Sales Forecasting Support: Provide order, backlog, shipment, and factory capacity data to support sales forecasting and production planning. * Operational Visibility: Provide timely updates on order status, delivery schedules, and outstanding issues to support customer management. * Operational Standards & Team Leadership * Operational Excellence: Develop and implement SOPs, coordinate cross-functional training, and ensure process compliance and consistency. * Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Operations Management team, strengthening multi-project management, independent decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Operation Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Role Overview** The Marketing Operations Manager is responsible for building the operational foundation that enables Cooler Master’s global marketing organization to plan, execute, measure, and scale effectively. This role connects strategy with execution by establishing clear processes, planning frameworks, governance, systems, budget controls, and performance reporting across Global Marketing, Regional Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, PR, Social, Digital, Creative, and Events. The ideal candidate is highly structured, analytical, and process-driven, with the ability to bring clarity and accountability to a complex global marketing organization. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Marketing Planning & Governance** * Own the global marketing planning process, including annual, quarterly, and campaign planning cycles. * Establish standardized planning templates, timelines, milestones, and approval processes. * Create clear governance between Global Marketing, Regional Marketing, Business Units, Product Teams, and Sales. * Ensure marketing activities align with company priorities and business objectives. * Establish ownership, accountability, and decision-making frameworks across marketing programs. **2. Marketing Process & Workflow** * Design and continuously improve end-to-end marketing workflows. * Standardize processes for campaigns, product launches, creative requests, PR, events, digital marketing, and regional activation. * Define roles, responsibilities, approval gates, and escalation paths. * Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve speed and execution quality. * Build scalable processes that support both Consumer and B2B marketing organizations. **3. Budget Management** * Own marketing budget tracking and governance across global and regional teams. * Establish budget planning, allocation, approval, and reporting processes. * Track budget vs. actual spending and identify variances. * Improve visibility into marketing investment by region, business unit, campaign, and function. * Partner with Finance and marketing leadership on forecasting and budget optimization. * Ensure marketing investments are properly documented and accountable. **4. Marketing Performance & Reporting** * Build standardized marketing dashboards and reporting frameworks. * Establish consistent KPI definitions across teams and regions. * Consolidate performance across Brand, PR, Social, Digital, Product Marketing, Channel Marketing, Events, and Regional Marketing. * Develop weekly, monthly, quarterly, and executive-level reporting. * Translate marketing data into actionable insights for leadership. * Improve visibility into marketing effectiveness and ROI. **5. Marketing Technology & Systems** * Own and optimize the marketing technology ecosystem. * Evaluate and implement tools for project management, campaign management, analytics, CRM integration, digital asset management, and reporting. * Ensure marketing teams use systems consistently and effectively. * Reduce unnecessary tools, duplicate workflows, and fragmented data. * Partner with IT, Sales Operations, and other functions on system integration and data governance. **6. Global & Regional Marketing Coordination** * Establish operating rhythms between Global Marketing and regional marketing teams. * Coordinate global marketing calendars, major campaigns, product launches, events, and strategic initiatives. * Ensure regional teams receive the assets, information, timelines, and guidance required for execution. * Improve visibility of regional marketing plans and activities for global leadership. * Facilitate cross-regional sharing of best practices and learnings. **7. Product Launch Operations** * Partner with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Creative, PR, Digital, and Regional Marketing to operationalize product launches. * Establish launch timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, and readiness criteria. * Maintain visibility into launch status and identify risks before they impact execution. * Ensure marketing deliverables are completed according to agreed launch milestones. * Conduct post-launch reviews and capture learnings for future launches. **8. Marketing Project Management & PMO** * Lead project management for major global marketing initiatives, campaigns, launches, events, and strategic programs. * Establish project scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and critical paths. * Run cross-functional project meetings and maintain action trackers. * Identify execution risks, bottlenecks, and resource conflicts and escalate them early. * Maintain executive-level visibility into project status. * Establish standardized project management methodologies and tools across Global Marketing. * Conduct post-project reviews and ensure key learnings are incorporated into future programs. **9.Agency & Vendor Operations** * Support agency and vendor management processes. * Establish consistent scopes of work, briefing processes, timelines, and performance expectations. * Maintain visibility into agency spending and deliverables. * Partner with Procurement and Finance where appropriate. * Help marketing leadership evaluate agency effectiveness and resource allocation. **Key Deliverables** * Annual Global Marketing Calendar * Marketing Planning Framework * Marketing Budget Dashboard * Global Marketing KPI Dashboard * Executive Marketing Scorecard * Campaign & Launch Governance Framework * Marketing Workflow / SOP Library * Global–Regional Operating Rhythm * Marketing Technology Roadmap * Resource & Capacity Planning * Quarterly Marketing Business Review * Post-Campaign / Post-Launch Review Framework **Key Performance Indicators** **Operational Excellence** * On-time campaign and launch delivery * Project milestone completion rate * Marketing workflow cycle time * Number of delayed / at-risk initiatives * Internal stakeholder satisfaction **Financial Management** * Budget utilization * Budget vs. actual variance * Forecast accuracy * Marketing spend visibility * Agency/vendor efficiency **Marketing Effectiveness** * Reporting completeness and accuracy * KPI adoption across regions * Campaign performance visibility * Marketing ROI / ROMI where measurable * Speed of executive reporting **Organizational Effectiveness** * Global/regional process adoption * Marketing tool adoption * Reduction in duplicated work * Cross-functional execution efficiency * Improvement in marketing planning accuracy **Experience & Qualifications** * 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Strategy, Business Operations, PMO, or related roles. * Experience working within a global or regional marketing organization. * Strong understanding of marketing planning, budgeting, reporting, and campaign operations. * Experience managing cross-functional projects involving Marketing, Product, Sales, Finance, and Creative teams. * Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. * Advanced proficiency in dashboards, reporting, spreadsheets, and project management systems. * Experience with marketing technology and automation platforms is preferred. * Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to operate effectively across multiple regions, cultures, and time zones.

new_jobs.title: Lead, Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Job Title:** Lead, Technical Program Manager **Job Description:** **The Role** Entegris is currently seeking a **Lead, Technical Program Manager (TPM),** to join our team. This position will be based in our Taiwan- KSP-N or TTC, or Korea – KTC facility. In this role, you will lead the execution of a strategically important portfolio of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs within our Formulated Solutions (FS) business unit. Working across R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Business, and customer-facing teams, you will drive alignment, manage risk, improve execution processes, and enable successful commercialization. You will provide leadership beyond individual projects by influencing key stakeholders, guiding cross-functional decision-making, advancing project management best practices, and delivering portfolio-level outcomes that support customer success and business growth in accordance with the company’s strategic objectives. **What You’ll Do** * Lead a portfolio of strategic, business-critical NPI programs, driving prioritization, execution, KPI visibility, risk management, and successful commercialization. * Partner with business and functional leaders to align priorities, resources, and program outcomes with FS and divisional strategy, providing portfolio-level insights and recommendations. * Improve NPI processes, tools, and governance to increase execution speed, resource efficiency, and organizational effectiveness. * Serve as a TPM SME by establishing best practices, coaching teams, and promoting consistent project management excellence. * Collaborate with business and customer-facing teams to develop customer communications that balance customer requirements, product positioning, and protection of proprietary information. **What We Seek** * Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or related degree/discipline is required; advanced degree preferred * 5+ years of experience leading new product development, commercialization, or technical programs within semiconductor fabrication consumables or a related industry. * Strong knowledge of semiconductor fabrication processes related to chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and technical fluency in CMP-related chemistry, engineering and manufacturing; a minimum of 3 years in a CMP-related role is highly preferred. * Demonstrated success leading complex, business-critical NPI programs from concept through commercialization while achieving customer, quality, schedule, and business objectives. * Advanced program and portfolio management skills, including prioritization, risk management, stakeholder alignment, conflict resolution, governance, and executive communication; PMP certification preferred. * Strong knowledge of stage-gate NPI processes with demonstrated experience leading cross-functional gate reviews, driving decisions, and ensuring commercialization readiness. * Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and build alignment across functions, levels, and geographies without direct authority. * Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business leaders, customer-facing organizations, and executive stakeholders. **Your success will be measured by:** * Successful management of a portfolio of NPIs that meet quality, customer, and business objectives * Influencing cross‑functional teams and leaders to drive alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making across complex programs. * Proactively identifying, mitigating, and escalating portfolio risks, dependencies, and resource constraints while clearly communicating tradeoffs and recommendations. * Improving NPI performance through enhanced processes, governance, KPIs, tools, and reporting that increase transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness. * Serving as a trusted TPM SME by establishing best practices, coaching teams, and driving consistent project management excellence across the organization. * High‑quality internal and external communication, ensuring stakeholders have the right level of information at the right time to support decision‑making, trust, and strategic alignment **Why Work at Entegris** Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. *Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.* *At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.*

new_jobs.title: Senior Principal Product Development Manager

product lifecycle data. • Build a scalable data foundation that enables analytics, automation, and AI-driven decision making. • Improve data quality, traceability, accessibility, and reusability across development functions. * Engineering Modernization & Transformation • Lead engineering modernization initiatives that simplify workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and improve execution new_jobs.title: Head of Operation
new_jobs.jd: A leading fashion retail organisation seeks a Head of Operations in Taiwan to lead Finance and HR functions, optimise workflows, and drive operational excellence, compliance, and organisational success. **Key Responsibilities** As Head of Operations, you will lead Finance and HR departments, strengthen operational efficiency and compliance, and drive continuous improvement through effective team management and cross-functional collaboration. * Oversee daily Finance and HR operations, managing work allocation, progress, quality, and team performance to ensure efficient and timely delivery * Establish and maintain departmental SOPs, internal management policies, and performance-tracking mechanisms to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and accountability * Lead accounting operations, including month-end and year-end closing, financial reporting, annual budgeting, expense control, cash flow management, and payment processing * Manage tax filings and external audits through coordination with external accountants, maintaining robust financial controls and compliance with Taiwan regulations and company policies * Oversee the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, employee records, payroll, bonuses, benefits, attendance, performance reviews, training, employee relations, and talent development * Ensure compliance with Taiwan labour laws and personal data protection requirements; coordinate with external legal and HR consultants, optimise workflows and system utilisation, strengthen cross-functional communication, reduce manual work and operational risks, and provide management reports on departmental progress, key issues, risks, and improvement recommendations **Candidate Profile** * Academic background or professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a closely related field * Proven experience in department management or team leadership, with experience overseeing both Finance and HR teams highly desirable * Comprehensive knowledge of Taiwan financial accounting standards, taxation rules, payroll systems, personnel administration practices, and relevant labour laws * Strong capabilities in work allocation, performance metrics management, workflow optimisation, cross-functional coordination, and continuous process improvement * Excellent communication, organisational planning, reporting, accountability, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in both Chinese and English preferred * Demonstrated understanding of internal controls and regulatory compliance requirements, with experience using management reporting tools to provide timely updates on progress, issues, risks, and recommendations **About This Company** This fashion retail organisation is recognised for its distinctive design, craftsmanship, and international presence. It fosters an inclusive and collaborative workplace, promoting employee wellbeing and long-term career growth through flexible working opportunities, generous pension contributions, and continuous training. **Keywords:** Finance Operations, Human Resources, Financial Accounting, Payroll Management, Regulatory Compliance **What’s Next** Lead operational excellence and shape the future of Finance and HR through impactful leadership and continuous improvement. Apply now!

Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world's most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. You will be responsible for strategic planning, stakeholder management, governance, and execution, ensuring projects meet client expectations, quality standards, and budgetary targets. This role also includes portfolio oversight, team development, contributing to business growth and innovation, and overseeing invoicing processes through D-365 to ensure financial accuracy and compliance. **Key Responsibilities** **Team Leadership & Development** * Mentor and develop junior project managers and team members through structured guidance, feedback, and performance reviews. * Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture that supports continuous learning and professional growth. * Demonstrate inclusive leadership by recognizing diverse perspectives and encouraging open dialogue. * Promote accountability, ownership, and ethical behavior across the team. * Adapt coaching style to suit individual team members’ strengths, development areas, and working styles. * Lead by example in demonstrating resilience, integrity, and a growth mindset. * Client & Stakeholder Engagement * Lead multidisciplinary project teams including clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout all project phases. * Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across all stakeholders through structured meetings, reporting, and documentation. * Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes. **Project Strategy & Planning** * Develop and lead the overall project execution strategy, defining critical success factors and key performance indicators (KPIs). * Drive strategic alignment of project goals with broader business objectives. * Establish robust project governance frameworks, reporting structures, and control mechanisms for quality, safety, compliance, risk, and environmental management. **Project Oversight & Governance** * Drive executive-level reporting and performance dashboards to support strategic decision-making across leadership. * Lead the implementation of robust project controls covering schedule, cost, risk, and change management, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. * Provide strategic direction for design development, ensuring compliance with client requirements, regulatory standards, and corporate objectives. * Lead end-to-end procurement processes—from tender strategy to vendor selection—ensuring transparency, governance compliance, and value creation. * Cultivate strong partnerships with consultants and vendors to drive accountability, performance, and continuous improvement. **Financial Oversight** * Monitor project budgets and financial performance in collaboration with cost management team. * Analyze cost drivers, manage variations, and report financial progress against budget. * Support commercial negotiations and contract administration. * Manage invoicing processes using D-365, including: + Reviewing and validating invoice data for accuracy and completeness. + Coordinating with finance teams to ensure timely submission and approval. + Tracking invoice status and resolving discrepancies. + Ensuring compliance with client billing requirements and internal financial controls. **Construction Oversight** * Conduct regular site inspections to monitor safety, quality, and progress, ensuring alignment with design intent, statutory requirements, and project milestones. * Collaborate closely with contractors, consultants, and site teams to proactively identify and resolve construction issues. * Manage permitting processes and statutory submissions to ensure timely approvals. **Business Development** * Contribute to business development initiatives, including proposal writing, client presentations, and market engagement to support growth and positioning. * Collaborate with internal teams to identify new opportunities, develop tailored solutions, and respond to client needs with agility and insight. * Demonstrate strategic thinking and commercial awareness in identifying trends, client priorities, and competitive differentiators. * Capture and share lessons learned, benchmarking data, and best practices to drive continuous improvement across projects and teams. **Resource Planning & Management** * Lead effective resource planning across projects to ensure timely delivery, cost efficiency, and alignment with business priorities. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to forecast resource needs, address skill gaps, and support team development and workload balancing. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or higher in construction-related fields such as architecture, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, or electrical engineering. * 15+ years of experience in industrial project management or construction projects * Architect, professional engineer, or relevant professional qualification in Taiwan or overseas preferred * Strong communication and leadership skills with experience in people management. * Strong business acumen, with the ability to drive outcomes on behalf of clients, develop new business, leverage current opportunities, and coordinate with construction and design teams to meet deadlines and deliverables * Experience in client management with solid experience in client facing environment that requires incumbent to utilise critical business development skills and advisory skills to enhance project delivery on value management, value engineering, and life cycle costing. * Business-level proficiency in English or Korean. **Additional Information** Our inspired people share our vision and mission. Price Rule、Discount Schedule，以及依報價類型與銷售通路反映折扣核准矩陣的核准流程。 • 負責權限模型、Profile 與權限設計，並擔任資安稽核中的 CRM 控管負責人。 • 處理業務系統管理員無法解決的複雜與升級 Salesforce 問題。 三、系統整合 • 透過 API 與中介軟體（Middleware），設計、建置並維護 Salesforce 與 ERP、行銷自動化、Partner Portal、Gong 及其他業務平台之間的整合。 • 監控整合健康度，訂定資料核對機制，並解決系統間的資料不一致。 • 撰寫開發技術規格，並審閱、測試及核准內部開發人員與外部廠商的交付內容。 四、AI 於業務營運的應用 • 主導 Salesforce AI 的導入策略與 Roadmap，從使用情境定義、試行驗證到規模化導入，全程負責。 • 評估並導入 Salesforce AI 功能（如 Einstein、Agentforce），提升業務生產力、資料品質與 Forecast 可視性。 • 設計並建置平台以外的 AI 營運自動化，例如以 AI Agent 或 LLM 執行的資料核對、稽核與資料品質流程，並訂定清楚的資料安全與正確性防護機制。 • 與業務營運團隊定義使用情境，衡量導入率與業務效益，持續優化或調整投入方向，確保資源用在真正產生價值的地方。 五、技術審閱與團隊賦能 • 審閱業務系統管理員的設定與上線內容，檢視正確性、可維護性與風險，並提供具體、實用的回饋。 • 指導團隊 Salesforce 最佳實務，將重複發生的問題轉為作業手冊與自動化。 • 撰寫架構、設定與作業程序文件，推動知識共享。 【必備條件】 • 至少 5 年 Salesforce 或業務系統經驗，其中至少 3 年實際設定經驗（Flow、權限、資料模型、驗證規則、報表）。具優秀專案成果者，可抵年資。 • 具將業務流程設計成系統的能力（例如 Quote to Order、Lead to Opportunity），並能說明設計背後的業務邏輯。 • 具 Salesforce 與外部業務系統（如 ERP、行銷自動化或 Partner Portal）透過 API 或中介軟體整合的實作經驗。 • 具 AI 應用於業務營運或業務系統的實務經驗，至少完成一個使用情境（Salesforce AI 或 AI Agent / LLM 流程皆可）。 • 能閱讀並審閱 Apex 程式碼，並能與開發人員及廠商有效合作；不要求本身具備 Apex 開發能力。 • 具支援多區域、跨時區業務使用者的經驗。 • 大學以上相關科系，或具同等實務經驗。 【加分條件】 • 具 Salesforce 認證（如 Administrator、Platform App Builder、Application Architect、CPQ Specialist 或 Agentforce Specialist）。 • 具深厚 Salesforce CPQ 經驗，包括 Price Rule、折扣核准流程與報價單範本。 • 具 HubSpot、Pardot 等行銷自動化平台、Gong 或 Impartner 等 Partner Portal 經驗。 • 曾擔任 CRM 資安控管負責人（如 ISO 27001）。 • 曾指導或審閱系統管理員的工作，並管理委外開發人員或廠商（含 UAT）。 • 熟悉敏捷（Agile）方法與 Jira 等專案工具。 【人格特質】 • 親自動手、具說服力：能實際示範怎麼做，而不只是描述。 • 系統化思考，能在快速修補與長期架構之間取得平衡。 • 能與業務主管及跨部門團隊清楚溝通，用業務語言說明技術決策。 • 中英文流利，能與不同時區的各區團隊合作。 • 能在快節奏的跨國環境中處理多項優先事項。 • 具團隊合作精神，樂於接受回饋。

new_jobs.title: FP&A – Post-Investment Management & Strategic Finance
new_jobs.jd: **About Bora** Bora Pharmaceuticals has grown through a series of acquisitions and strategic investments across CDMO, pharmaceutical and biologics businesses. This role sits at the centre of that growth. As Senior Financial Analyst / Finance Manager, FP&A – Post-Investment Management & Strategic Finance, you will make sure every acquired or invested business delivers on its investment case, and you will give the CFO Office the analysis it needs for group planning, capital allocation and strategic decisions. You will own post-investment performance tracking, support the Long-Range Plan (LRP) and annual budget, build and maintain financial models, and lead high-priority strategic finance projects. You will work closely with subsidiary finance teams, Business Development, Corporate Strategy, Operations and Treasury, and present findings and recommendations directly to senior leadership. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Post-Investment Management** • Track the performance of acquired businesses and strategic investments against the original deal model and investment thesis, covering revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, ROIC, IRR and payback. • Build and maintain a standard post-investment monitoring framework, including KPI dashboards, monthly and quarterly review packs, and variance analysis against the deal case and budget. • Monitor synergy realization (revenue, cost and capacity synergies) and integration milestones, and flag risks and corrective actions to management early. • Work with subsidiary finance teams to align reporting standards, chart of accounts, planning calendars and management reporting with group requirements. • Prepare investment review materials for the CFO, management meetings and the Board, including look-back analyses of completed transactions. • Support earn-out, contingent consideration and other deal-related tracking, together with Accounting and Legal. • Maintain the financial models used for annual goodwill and intangible asset impairment testing, in partnership with Accounting and external auditors. **2. Strategic Finance and Long-Range Plan** • Support the group Long-Range Plan and annual budget process, including consolidating inputs from business units and subsidiaries and maintaining planning models and materials. • Use benchmarking and peer analysis (global CDMO and specialty pharma peers) to challenge and validate forecast assumptions and outputs. • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to support leadership discussions on trade-offs across organic investment, capacity expansion (CAPEX), M&A and shareholder returns. • Partner with Business Development and Corporate Strategy on financial evaluation of new opportunities, including valuation (DCF, comparable), deal modelling and accretion/dilution analysis, and support due diligence where needed. • Support portfolio prioritization, including evaluation of products, sites or businesses for growth, restructuring or divestiture. • Improve expense transparency and cost-driver analysis across the group to support cost management and productivity initiatives. **3. Strategic Projects** Lead or support high-priority strategic finance initiatives through rigorous analysis, structured project management, cross-functional collaboration and clear communication to leadership. Examples include evaluating business performance and cost drivers, identifying productivity and margin-improvement opportunities, assessing operating-model or resource-allocation alternatives, and developing business cases for major CAPEX or new business initiatives. Qualifications **Basic Qualifications** • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree / MBA with 3+ years of relevant experience. • At least 4 years of experience at a public accounting (CPA) firm. • Experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, corporate development, M&A, investment banking, private equity or management consulting. • Advanced financial modelling and Excel skills; strong PowerPoint skills. • Professional proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese, written and spoken. **Preferred Qualifications** • Post-acquisition or portfolio management experience (for example, PMI, portfolio company monitoring at a PE fund, or group-level subsidiary performance management). • Experience in pharmaceutical, CDMO, biotech or healthcare industries. • Solid understanding of financial statements, valuation concepts, forecasting and business drivers; working knowledge of IFRS, including goodwill impairment and purchase price allocation. • Experience working with multinational subsidiaries across time zones (for example, US, Canada, Europe or Asia). • Hands-on experience with ERP (such as SAP or Oracle), planning tools and BI tools (such as Power BI). • CFA, CPA or equivalent professional qualification is a plus. **Competencies** • Analytical thinker with sound judgment, strong business acumen and attention to detail. • Able to turn complex information into clear, concise messages for senior leadership audiences. • Builds productive relationships across functions and geographies, and influences without direct authority. • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, M&A-driven environment and manages multiple priorities and deadlines with follow-through. • High integrity in handling confidential and price-sensitive information.

new_jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Forming Our Future together** FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. **Job Description** Regional Marketing Manager, Taiwan *Probes Business Unit | Taiwan (Zhubei, Hsinchu County) | Reports to the Senior Director, Regional Marketing* **About The Role** FormFactor is seeking an experienced Regional Marketing Manager to lead commercial marketing strategy for the Probes Business Unit in Taiwan. This role works side by side with account managers and regional sales leaders to shape how we win and grow at Taiwan’s foundries and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers, which together sit at the center of the global semiconductor supply chain. You will own pricing strategy, long-term volume and capacity agreements, account-based demand forecasts, and the clear communication of our product value. Regional Marketing complements account management rather than replacing it. In Taiwan, the focus is on large strategic accounts in two areas: leading-edge and specialty foundries, and OSATs and independent test houses providing wafer sort, advanced packaging, and final test services. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad visibility and significant influence on BU pricing, demand, and market share outcomes. Customers and End Markets * Leading-edge and specialty foundries: Taiwan foundries manufacturing advanced logic, AI accelerator, mobile, RF, power, and specialty devices for global fabless and IDM customers. Their node migrations, wafer sort requirements, and capacity expansions drive demand for high-performance probe card solutions. You will build account strategies that reflect their technology roadmaps, node transitions, fab ramps, and qualification cycles. * OSATs and independent test houses: assembly and test providers supporting wafer sort, advanced packaging, and final test for fabless, foundry, and IDM customers. Growth in 2.5D and 3D packaging, chiplets, and known-good-die requirements is raising the technical bar for probing. You will develop pricing approaches, agreement structures, and value propositions that reflect multi-customer test floors, capacity utilization economics, and service-level expectations. * Ecosystem influence: in many programs, probe card decisions involve the foundry or OSAT together with the end customer that designs the device. You will map these decision chains and coordinate with FormFactor teams in other regions so that commercial strategies stay aligned across the full supply chain. Key Responsibilities Account Strategy and Market Share * Develop and execute account-specific strategies for Taiwan foundry and OSAT strategic accounts to grow and defend market share. * Partner with account managers and regional sales leaders on account plans, executive engagements, and negotiation strategy. * Track competitive activity, including local and regional probe card suppliers, along with customer technology transitions, advanced packaging adoption, and new program awards, and adjust account strategy accordingly. * Coordinate with FormFactor teams in North America, Korea, Japan, Singapore, and Europe on programs where the device designer and the foundry or OSAT sit in different regions. * Provide regional input to the BU’s market share strategy and to the global portfolio and pricing decisions. Pricing and Commercial Agreements * Develop pricing strategies for foundry and OSAT accounts that reflect product value, competitive position, volume commitments, cost of test, and program lifecycle. * Serve as a key participant in BU pricing approvals for the region, helping to shorten approval turnaround times while maintaining consistency with global pricing for the same programs. * Structure and negotiate long-term volume agreements and purchase and capacity agreements that improve demand predictability for FormFactor and its customers. * Develop commercial models suited to OSAT and test house business models, including multi-customer programs, repair and service offerings, and consumables. * Monitor price realization and agreement performance, and recommend adjustments when results differ from plan. Value Proposition * Translate product capabilities and performance data into customer-specific value propositions for existing products, with an emphasis on throughput, yield, uptime, and total cost of test on high-volume test floors. * Equip account managers with materials, proof points, and economic models that clearly communicate value to technical and commercial decision makers, in both English and Traditional Chinese where needed. * Bring customer feedback and competitive insight back to Product Line Management to inform roadmaps and positioning, particularly for advanced packaging and known-good-die requirements. Demand Planning and SIOP * Build account-based forecasts for Taiwan foundry and OSAT strategic accounts using customer roadmaps, fab and test capacity plans, program timing, and signed commitments. * Reconcile Taiwan demand with forecasts from other regions so that programs designed elsewhere but tested in Taiwan are captured once and accurately. * Contribute regional demand inputs to the long-range plan and the SIOP process, helping ensure that demand is accurately represented to Operations and Finance. * Work with Sales Operations and Operations planning to align customer commitments with capacity, local service support, and lead-time expectations. Cross-Functional Collaboration * Partner with Product Line Management on portfolio priorities, new product introductions, and lifecycle plans for products serving Taiwan foundry and OSAT accounts. * Work with Product Enablement and the Taiwan Service Center’s applications engineering, design, field service, and repair teams on customer requirements for new designs, first article vehicles, and qualification. * Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Engineering, and executive leadership to align commercial commitments with business objectives. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred. * 8+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, strategic marketing, key account management, or commercial strategy in semiconductors, semiconductor equipment, advanced packaging, or test. * Proven experience developing pricing strategies and negotiating complex commercial agreements with strategic customers in Taiwan or the broader Asia-Pacific region. * Working knowledge of foundry and OSAT business models, wafer sort and final test flows, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D integration and chiplets, and how they affect probe card and test requirements. * Established relationships within Taiwan’s semiconductor ecosystem strongly preferred. * Experience building account-based forecasts and contributing to demand planning or SIOP processes. * Strong analytical and financial skills, including comfort with business cases, price and volume trade-offs, and market data. * Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Operations,
